The 2025 Mansory G63 is one of the most extreme interpretations of the already formidable Mercedes G-Class. Inside, the cabin becomes a showcase of individuality. Virtually every surface can be re-trimmed in leather and Alcantara, with special quilting, custom colors and bespoke trim pieces throughout. Representing the outer edge of luxury SUV customization, the 2025 Mansory G63 stands as both a performance powerhouse and a rolling work of taste. The 2025 Subaru Outback Onyx Edition is a rugged yet stylish trim that blends everyday comfort with off-road capability. It stands out visually with black-finish wheels, dark exterior accents, and raised roof rails, giving it a more aggressive, outdoors-focused look. Inside, it features durable Star-Tex upholstery with contrast stitching, designed to handle wear from active lifestyles while still offering a modern, upscale feel.

Under the hood, the Onyx Edition comes standard with a 2.5-liter SUBARU BOXER engine producing about 182 horsepower, paired with a continuously variable transmission and Subarus signature symmetrical all-wheel drive. It delivers solid efficiency around 26/32 MPG city/highway while maintaining strong capability with features like dual-function X-MODE and up to 9.5 inches of ground clearance for tackling rough terrain. A more powerful turbocharged version is available in the Onyx Edition XT for drivers who want extra performance and towing capacity.

Technology and safety are also key highlights, with standard Eye-Sight driver-assist systems that include adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, and pre-collision braking. The interior is anchored by an 11.6-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, along with a Harman Kardon premium audio system for a high-quality listening experience. Overall, the Onyx Edition offers a strong balance of practicality, advanced safety, and adventure-ready features, making it one of the most versatile trims in the Outback lineup.

A one-owner 2025 Subaru Outback Onyx Edition is the kind of vehicle Northeast Ohio selects you back- built for the mud on the way to Cuyahoga Valley, the lake-effect miles on Route 2, and every back road between here and wherever you're headed next. Under 16,000 miles, clean CARFAX, and Subaru Certified Pre-Owned backed from a single Ohio owner.

This Outback Onyx Edition carries a spotless CARFAX- no accidents reported, no structural damage, no airbag events, clean title throughout. It was purchased new from Adventure Subaru in November 2024 and has been serviced here consistently ever since: oil and filter changes at 4,118, 9,827, and 12,443 miles, a tire rotation, and an alignment check, all on record. The original factory warranty remains active with an estimated 19 months and over 20,000 miles still remaining. As a Subaru Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, this CPO Outback has completed a 152-point inspection and carries a 7-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty with a $0 deductible, roadside assistance, and coverage that transfers to the next owner.

One owner, entirely Ohio-owned, serviced exclusively at Adventure Subaru, and averaging well under 15,000 miles per year a 2025 model with this kind of paper trail doesn't show up often.

Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive with X-Mode Dual-Mode traction management gives the Outback the composure to handle whatever Northeast Ohio puts in the way- deep snow, wet leaves on a county road, or a trailhead parking lot that's seen better days. The four-wheel independent raised suspension rides at 8.7 inches of ground clearance, and the LED steering-responsive headlights track with the road on dark, winding nights. EyeSight Driver Assist Technology adaptive cruise control with lane centering, automatic emergency braking with automatic emergency steering, blind spot detection, and rear cross-traffic alert handles the high-attention work so you can stay focused on the drive itself.

Inside, the Onyx Edition's StarTex water-repellent upholstery earns its place on a vehicle like this- it handles wet gear, muddy dogs, and post-hike passengers without complaint. The All-Weather Package adds heated front seats and a heated steering wheel for the months when Northeast Ohio demands both. The 10-way power driver's seat with 2-way lumbar adjusts to you, not the other way around. The 11.6-inch STARLINK Multimedia Plus touchscreen keeps the interface clean and accessible, and the Harman Kardon audio system makes long drives worth stretching out. Keyless access with push-button start, a hands-free power liftgate, and integrated retractable roof crossbars round out the practical side the crossbars stow flush when you don't need them and deploy quickly when you do. Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, SiriusXM, and dual-zone climate control cover the rest. The dealer-added all-weather floor liners are already in place.

26 city/32 highway MPG.

At Adventure Subaru, Subaru Certified Pre-Owned isn't a checkbox it's a commitment. Our factory-trained technicians complete the 152-point inspection, and we stand behind the coverage long after you drive home. Find us at 1991 Mentor Ave, Painesville, Ohio.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Safety and Security
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them.
